maya_cs: Quick weekly pulse on HelioWorks — noticed a sharp bump in token throughput overnight. QoW +18%, QoQ +44%. Dropping a short summary and tickets below.

maya_cs: Baseline (last week avg/day): 120M tokens -> current 142M tokens/day (WoW +18%). QoQ baseline was ~98M/day -> now 142M (+44%).

omar_csm: Thanks Maya — which routes/models are driving this? Any specific customer flows?

maya_cs: Mostly `helio.prod.chat` (model-a/v2) for a new feature rollout. Top contributor is a retry loop from their backend that increased requests per session. Seen higher prefix reuse but also more short-lived sessions so batching less efficient.

lucy_ops: Observed p95 latency drift on the same route: last week p95 ~310ms, today p95 ~520ms. Error rate jumped from 0.2% -> 1.1% (502/504 from edge). Cache hit-rate for prefix cache dropped from 68% -> 44%.

deploy-bot: :warning: Alert: route=helio.prod.chat model=model-a/v2 error_rate=1.1% p95_latency=520ms window=30m

quinn_sales: Is this impacting their SLA? Any risk of renewal friction? They hit the enterprise threshold last quarter.

maya_cs: Short answer: potentially. Their spend WoW +27%, so revenue impact is positive, but UX degradation could surface in support tickets. We should proactively sync.

omar_csm: Can you paste the query you used? I'll pull a per-route breakdown and reach out to the customer if needed.

maya_cs: Query I used (internal analytics):
```
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) AS tok_day, PERCENTILE(latency_ms, 95) AS p95, SUM(errors)/SUM(requests) AS err_rate
FROM telemetry.tokens
WHERE org_id = 'helioworks' AND timestamp >= now()-interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tok_day DESC
```

lucy_ops: Quick findings from infra side: increased cold starts on the dedicated pool last night (autoscaler churn). A misconfigured cooldown caused scale-down too fast -> rebuilds -> transient 502s. I’ve opened ENG-5632 to relax cooldown and bump min replicas.

maya_cs: Nice. Can you estimate expected latency improvement after patch?

lucy_ops: Expect p95 to drop to ~330-360ms within 30 minutes of stabilizing pools. Cache hit-rate should recover as sessions stabilize.

quinn_sales: I'll draft a short customer note: acknowledge we saw an infra-induced spike, working mitigation, asking if they saw visible UX regressions. Want to preempt support/CS escalation.

omar_csm: Action items:
- lucy_ops: deploy cooldown fix + bump min replicas (ENG-5632) — ETA 45m
- maya_cs/quinn_sales: send customer note once infra confirms stabilization — ETA 1h
- maya_cs: run a quick prompt set eval to ensure generation quality unchanged — ETA 2h

maya_cs: Also monitoring spend: estimated incremental spend this week ~ $3.2k above baseline (mostly model-a/v2). Recommend discussing rate-limiting retry pattern with customer SDK team.

quinn_sales: I'll propose a best-practice doc + small design call to reduce retries and leverage streaming + prefix caching.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: ENG-5632 updated: cooldown 600s -> 1200s; min_replicas 3 -> 5. Change deployed to staging at 2038123650.

lucy_ops: Changes deployed to prod at 2038123775. Monitoring now.

lucy_ops: Early signs good — error rate trending down from 1.1% -> 0.28% in last 10m, p95 trending toward 360ms.

maya_cs: Great. I'll hold the customer note until we see stable metrics for 30m. If stable, we'll send: brief incident summary, mitigations taken, recommended SDK changes.

omar_csm: Thanks team. Marking this thread resolved once customer notified and metrics stable for 1h.

quinn_sales: :eyes: prepping note, will tag maya_cs for final review.

maya_cs: TL;DR: HelioWorks saw token throughput surge (WoW +18%, QoQ +44%), infra autoscale churn caused latency & errors, fix deployed (ENG-5632), monitoring shows recovery. Next: customer sync + retry-rate guidance.
